tasks.title: Retry the charge step on 502
tasks.description:
The payment provider answers **502** under load.

| attempt | wait | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 s | 502 |
| 2 | 1 s | 502 |
| 3 | 4 s | 200 |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Charge] -->|502| B{Retry?}
  B -->|attempt < 3| A
  B -->|no| C[Fail order]
```

- retry twice with backoff
- log the attempt count, see [the provider docs](https://example.com/payments)
